name: dev-memory-experience-registry
title: Register the dev-memory experience ledger so capturing a lesson is not an out-of-scope diff
description: dev_memory_capture writes .lattice/dev-memory/experience.jsonl, which has no runtime-artifact-registry entry, so the scope gate fails it closed as OUT_OF_SCOPE and reports blocking. Its sibling .lattice/dev-memory/finish-decisions/ IS registered with materialHash exclude, and that entry comment records the identical problem being fixed there. Every story that reaches DONE with a lesson worth recording hits this, and the cheapest way past it today is to declare no-reusable-lesson and skip the capture.
source: B-9ff1 DONE closeout: delivery reviewer traced the blocking scope report to a missing sibling entry in runtime-artifact-registry.ts
